structured.label: eGFR 10 mL/min/1.73m2 or higher
structured.note: Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3); the study does not name a formula.

structured.label: Urine albumin/creatinine ratio above 100 mg/g
structured.note: Stability of creatinine over 30 days is not checked.

structured.label: Hemoglobin below 8 g/dL
structured.note: Active gastrointestinal bleeding is not checked.

structured.label: Malignancy or history of malignancy
structured.note: Coded: breast cancer, leukemia and metastatic prostate cancer found in the Synthea sample. Neoplasm of prostate (may be benign) and carcinoma in situ are left out; they, all other cancers and the 5-year window rely on the free text.

structured.label: eGFR 30 mL/min/1.73m2 or higher
structured.note: Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3); the study does not name a formula.

structured.label: eGFR 25 mL/min/1.73m2 or higher
structured.note: Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3); the study does not name a formula.

structured.label: Urine albumin/creatinine ratio 300 mg/g or higher
structured.note: The clinical diagnosis of chronic kidney disease is not coded and relies on the free text.

structured.label: Blood potassium above 4.9 mmol/L
structured.note: Synthea often records potassium in blood (LOINC 6298-4); used as a stand-in for the plasma value.

structured.label: Established cardiovascular disease, including prior events
structured.note: Coded: ischemic heart disease, myocardial infarction, chronic heart failure and valvular disease found in the Synthea sample. Stroke, peripheral arterial disease, atrial fibrillation and treated hypertension rely on the free text. Chronic heart failure (88805009) does not record the ejection fraction: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction is excluded by exc-1 (free text), so a match here still needs that check.

structured.label: Type 2 diabetes
structured.note: Type 1 diabetes is not coded in the Synthea sample and relies on the free text.
